info.name: Sanguine Chapter
info.description: The Sanguine Chapter subclass for the Jaeger from Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024).
info.author: MonkeyDM

element.name: Sanguine Chapter
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: In order to strengthen themselves, jaegers of the Sanguine Chapter rely on the mastery of blood. They achieve resilient states of unnatural life and feed their powers with the fruits of their violence. Although some consider them to be monsters, when faced with the horrors of the Scourge, the sentiment quickly changes. These jaeger's abilities can hold the line and preserve the tenuous flame of life when it should have long since been extinguished, keeping themselves and their allies alive while draining the strength of their enemies in an endless crimson parade of blood.

element.name: Level 3: Vital Consumption
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You gain the ability to draw power from the flowing blood of your foes. You learn the Blood Drain Finisher, which does not count against your Finishers known.
Some of your abilities use a Blood Magic save DC, which is calculated as follows:

center.p: Blood Magic save DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Intelligence or Constitution modifier (your choice).

element.name: Intelligence
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: Use Intelligence for your Blood Magic save DC.

element.name: Constitution
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: Use Constitution for your Blood Magic save DC.

element.name: Blood Drain
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: As a Bonus Action, you expend all of your Momentum dice to drain the blood of a creature within 15 feet of you, magically consuming its vitality to empower you. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. Roll all of your expended Momentum dice, on a failed save the target takes Necrotic damage equal to the total rolled, or half as much on a successful save. Success or failure, you regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt. If this would restore you above your Hit Point maximum, you gain the excess as Temporary Hit Points

If the target has the Bloodied condition or is otherwise bleeding from an ability (such as the Hemorrhaging Wound finisher), it automatically fails its saving throw against this finisher, and you regain 1 Adrenaline Point.

sheet.description: Target within 15 ft makes a DC{{blood magic:dc}} Con save (auto-fails if Bloodied or bleeding, and you regain 1 Adrenaline Point). Fail: Necrotic damage equal to all expended Momentum dice. Success: Half damage. You regain HP equal to half Necrotic damage dealt (excess becomes THP).

element.name: Level 3: Crimson Rage
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: When you become Bloodied, you regain 1 Adrenaline Point and gain 1 Momentum die. You cannot benefit from this feature again for 1 minute.

sheet.description: When you become Bloodied, you regain 1 Adrenaline Point and gain 1 Momentum die.

element.name: Level 7: Blood Hex
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: When you use a Finisher against a target with Bloodied condition, you can force one target hit by the Finisher to make a Constitution saving throw against your Blood Magic save DC, selecting one of the following effects. You can use one of these effects when using your Blood Drain Finisher even if the target does not have the Bloodied condition, and when using that Finisher it uses the Finisher's saving throw rather than making a separate saving throw.

ul.li: Blood Puppet. The target must use its Reaction to move up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice (if the target's Reaction is unavailable, it cannot move).
Bound Blood. The target's Speed is halved until the start of your next turn.
Burning Blood. The target takes Fire damage equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt.

sheet.description: When using a Finisher against a Bloodied target (or any target via Blood Drain), force a DC{{blood magic:dc}} Con save (uses Blood Drain's save) for one effect: • Blood Puppet: Target uses its Reaction to move up to 5 ft in a direction of your choice. • Bound Blood: Target's Speed is halved until the start of your next turn. • Burning Blood: Target takes Fire damage equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt.

When using a Finisher against a Bloodied target (or any target via Blood Drain), force a DC{{blood magic:dc}} Con save (uses Blood Drain's save) for one effect (or spend 2 Adrenaline Points for an Empowered version): • Blood Puppet: Target uses Reaction to move up to 5 ft. Empowered (2 AP): Move up to 10 ft and make 1 weapon attack against a creature of your choice. • Bound Blood: Speed halved until start of your next turn. Empowered (2 AP): Target is Restrained until start of your next turn. • Burning Blood: Fire damage = half Necrotic damage dealt. Empowered (2 AP): At start of each of its turns, target takes Fire damage = Necrotic damage dealt (Con save at end of turns to end).

element.name: Level 14: Empowered Blood Hex
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: You can invoke more powerful blood hexes. You gain the following options for your Blood Hex feature, each of which are improved versions of the hexes granted by Blood Hex, but cost 2 Adrenaline Points to invoke.

ul.li: Blood Puppet (Empowered). The target must use its Reaction to move up to 10 feet and make a single weapon attack against a creature of your choice (if the target's Reaction is unavailable, it cannot move).
Bound Blood (Empowered). The target gains the Restrained condition until the start of your next turn.

Burning Blood (Empowered). At the start of each of its turns, the target takes Fire damage equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. The target can repeat the saving throw it made against the Blood Drain Finisher at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

element.name: Level 17: Blood Frenzy
element.source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt (2024)

description.p: While you have the Bloodied condition you gain the following benefits:

ul.li: Your Speed is increased by 20 feet.
When you take the Attack action, the number of attacks you make increases to three.

All Hit Points you regain from your Jaeger abilities are doubled. If an ability would restore you to no longer having the Bloodied condition, the effects of this ability do not fade until the end of your turn.
You can use the Blood Craze Adrenaline Art.

sheet.description: While Bloodied (lasts until end of turn if healed above Bloodied): • Speed increases by 20 feet. • Attack action grants 3 attacks. • All HP regained from Jaeger abilities are doubled. • You can use the Blood Craze Adrenaline Art.
